Title: General availability: Azure DNS in China regions

Body.Content:
Azure DNS is now generally available in Azure China regions. This means that you can now host public DNS zones on name servers located in Azure China regions. These DNS zones are globally resolvable but hosted within Azure China regions and meet local compliance and regulatory requirements.

Azure DNS provides a highly reliable, fast, secure and scalable solution for hosting public DNS zones. Using Azure DNS you can host your public DNS zones in the cloud in a matter of minutes, without having to worry about maintaining and securing eloborate DNS infrastructure. Click here to know more about Azure DNS.
